<subject>Reminder -- Last Day to Provide Input on Naming of Meridian Law & Advisory LLP Family Room!</subject>
<body>
As Meridian finalises plans for our new family room set to open in the 3rd quarter of next year, we are seeking input on 5 alternative names/concepts for the room’s designation. If you’ve already given feedback, THANKS!

If you have not, please take 5 minutes to visit FL 12A2 from 11-1 TODAY to share your opinion.

Feel free to bring a colleague! FREE refreshments will be provided!

Please forward this email to any other Meridian employees who may want to contribute their input on the naming of the family room.

We look forward to seeing you later today!

Regards,

Grace Elliott  
Executive Assistant  
Meridian Law & Advisory LLP  
Tel: +44 20 7946 0837  
grace.elliott@meridianlaw.com
</body>
